title: Finite realization of the positive tower Chern adjunct
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, Noetherian schemes X and S, the actual tower base b, f:X→S, and an isomorphism e:X≅P¹_S over S [def-sp-tower-shriek-data, def-sp-tower-class-diagonal]. Let g be its normalized tower geometry, cp its coefficient pullback, and cX Chern data satisfying FiniteChernNormalization [def-sp-tower-class-finite]. Suppose l is invertible on S and the level n+1 quotient R is finite; its annihilating exponent is the quotient equation [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients]. Write A=ULift R and F for the canonical fixed-scalar associated-module realization [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-direct-adjunction]. There are isomorphisms a from the evaluated tower coefficient unit to D(F)(geoP1Unit A S), and v from the evaluated direct image of the positive tower Tate line shifted by two to D(F)(Rp_*geoP1Twist A P¹_S 1 2). They give the arrow equality Ev(adjunct(cp;c₁(e*O(1))));v = a;D(F)(inr;geoP1TwistedMap), where the right side is the specified positive Kummer Chern adjunct in [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology]. This asserts only a comparison of positive adjuncts, with no negative twist, no H², and no invertibility of G2.

proof.text: Choose the constant/root-section coefficient coordinates and the finite realization pull/push isomorphisms p,q. Their unit equation and coefficient equation fix the adjunction and coefficient pullback. Independently realize the unadjointed normalized Kummer Chern class on X using those same coordinates, obtaining the target-line isomorphism t.

Expand the tower adjunct as the adjunction unit followed by push of the arrow. Naturality of pushEvaluation and geometry_adjunction_evaluation give the finite adjunct of inverse pullEvaluation followed by the evaluated arrow. This is the proved generic helper evaluation_adjunct, applied to cp.derivedIso followed by firstChern.

Compose pushEvaluation, finite direct image of t, and q to form v. The scalar Chern square and coefficient square identify its finite unadjointed arrow with L_fin(a);p;H(unitPullback;positiveChern). Naturality of the finite adjunction unit and of q, followed by its unit equation, give a;F of the ordinary adjunct. The proved helper finiteP1PositiveClass_adjunct identifies that adjunct with inr;geoP1TwistedMap by expanding the specified etale Chern component and the site-comparison mate.

theorem diagonalTrace_finite_chern_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) {f : X ⟶ S}
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (he : e.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (cp : CoefficientPullback l E b f g)
    (cX : Chern l E X) (hc : FiniteChernNormalization l E cX)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (n : ℕ) [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)] :
    let A := FiniteRing l E n
    let hA : ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : A) = 0 :=
      ULift.ext _ _ (coefficient_annihilates l E n)
    let hNS : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(S, ⊤)) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hS.pow (n + 1)
    let F := (Scheme.sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence S (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)).functor
    let adjunct := (SpTowerShriek.adjunction l E b g).homEquiv _ _
      ((cp.derivedIso l E).hom ≫
        firstChern l E cX (Scheme.Pic.mapHom e.hom (hyperplanePic S)))
    ∃ (a : (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E S n).obj (unit S (Arings l E S)) ≅
        F.mapDerivedCategory.obj (geoP1Unit A S))
      (v : (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E S n).obj
          ((SpTowerShriek.push l E b g).obj ((line l E cX)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) ≅
        F.mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((geoP1Pushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).obj
            (geoP1Twist A (l ^ (n + 1)) hA (ProjectiveLine S) 1 2))),
      (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E S n).map adjunct ≫ v.hom =
        a.hom ≫ F.mapDerivedCategory.map
          (biprod.inr ≫ geoP1TwistedMap A (l ^ (n + 1))
            (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hA S hNS)
